name: Copper Awnings
description:
Copper Awnings

Copper awnings make a great accent as a window or door awning. Copper is also a great material for an outdoor awning as the natural metal accents stone, brick and stucco and provides years of durable, long lasting service. Nothing complements a window or door quite like a copper awning. Not only do they provide a timeless look, awnings also offer year-round cover from the elements whether it’s southern heat or northern cold and ice. Copper is also known for its durability and low maintenance. Your copper awning will have no problem lasting you years without issue no matter what kind of climate you live in, and you won’t have to worry about cleaning it as copper awnings develop a natural patina over time. Take a look through our selection of copper awnings above. These are the sizes and styles of awnings for both doors and windows that are most popular with our customers. We also carry a wide variety of brackets to choose from as well, so you can get the fit and look you want, no matter where on your home you’re planning on installing a copper awning. The examples below are all listed in their standard sizes and dimensions. But rest assured we can customize any of these copper awnings in order to match your needs. Plus, each one was handmade right here in the US.

name: Copper Chimney Caps
description:
Adding Timeless Beauty to Your Home with Copper Chimney Caps

There are many different substances that can be used to build the chimney to your home or building. Some prefer a wooden chimney chase, however, the most common materials utilized are concrete, brick, stone, and other masonry, until now. Metal has recently become a popular new type of chimney material, and it makes a stylish and elegant addition to almost any building. However, if you do not feel like replacing your chimney to a metallic alternative due to the expense or inconvenience, there is another route you can try that will have basically the same effect. You see, there is an extended, single flue, or chimney pipe, that protrudes above your mantle and extends all the way to the top of your chimney. There, you will find there is room for you to install a fully-functional, yet ornamental, chimney cap on top of the chimney pipe. Chimney caps are lovely adornments made from different types of metal, such as stainless steel, aluminum, and copper. That said, if you are looking for top-of-the line, exquisite chimney caps, copper is the way to go. Whether you constantly clean them, or you allow them to go through the oxidation process and develop a natural, gorgeous patina, they are an elegant addition to any home or building. And, we even have several options that are pre-weathered to perfection if you prefer that look immediately.

Pick your Favorite Copper Chimney Cap for your Flue(s)

Did you know that if you are a patina lover, you don’t even have to wait the several years that it takes for copper oxidation to take place? You can purchase a chemically-aged copper chimney cap to get that enriched look that adds sophistication to any home or building. After all, if your home or building has a classic architectural style, you wouldn’t want to add a shiny, new-looking cap. Another option is the brown patina cap. It has a deep hue that emboldens the appearance of your chimney while still giving it that distinguished character with the chemically-induced aging. The novel finish provides your copper chimney cap with an interesting look that cannot be achieved through natural aging.

Copper Chimney Cap Advantages

There is a beauty provided by copper chimney caps that adds to the facade of any home or building. However, they are more than just extraneous baubles added without a purpose. They provide many functions and benefits that homeowners may not be aware of. Here are just a few of these advantages:

Keeping Out Weather, Pests, and Debris

Copper chimney caps are strong and sturdy. The durable rain caps can withstand nearly all of the most extreme weather conditions. This is especially important if you reside in an area where you experience all four seasons. So, whether you are enduring tornadoes and severe thunderstorms in the summer, or intense winds and freezing cold in the depths of winter, your copper chimney cap will stay in place and remain unaffected. In addition, your high-quality copper chimney cap is sure to shield your home or building from all pests and animal intruders that may try to make their way inside.

Decreasing your Downdraft

Well-designed HY-C copper chimney caps can actually reduce the amount of downdraft from the chimney pot felt inside the building. It does this by allowing more gas and smoke to escape the fireplace through the chimney, since high temperatures from the chimney flue, or chimney pipe, do not affect a high-quality cap. This means that your fireplace will be better ventilated and your chimney will perform greater over the long term. This is especially true if you have multiple flues, though it still makes a difference even if you only need a single flue chimney cap.

Copper Sheet Metal is Completely Malleable

Copper is so flexible that it can be molded into any shape that you desire. That means that your copper chimney cap can be created to fit your taste. Whether you prefer a circular domed type, or a rectangular or square type with clean lines, you will be covered. A new triangular type with long, sweeping wings is also gaining in popularity, and many customers opt for it.

Retrofitting is Never a Problem

If you are constructing a new building or home, or you are remodeling an existing structure, you can easily retrofit any chimney and flue with a copper chimney cap due to the sheer number of different models available.

Leaving Rust Behind

Chimney caps made from other metals, such as stainless steel chimney caps, or those made from galvanized steel, usually rust over time. This is due to being exposed to the elements year after year, and it is mostly unavoidable. Countless hours of repair and upkeep will only put off the inevitable – replacement. Conversely, copper chimney caps are known for their durability. They are long-lasting chimney covers and require next to no maintenance.

Create a Copper Chimney Cap of your Own

Copper is strong, sturdy, and beautiful, and, as such, is the perfect material to create custom chimney caps. High-quality copper lasts a lifetime and it is easy to size and position. Let the professional installers at Crescent City Copper assist you with creating the best copper chimney cap to match the roofing of your home or building. It is hard to beat our dedicated, handcrafted workmanship. We offer a plethora of copper chimney caps in several shapes, sizes, and styles, and that means you are sure to find one that suits your needs regardless of your type of chimney. Take a look at our online catalog today at www.crescentcitycopper.com. Do you have any questions or concerns? Give us a call at 1-877-251-5327 or shoot us an email at info@crescentcitycopper.com.

name: Copper Cupolas Handmade in New Orleans
description:
Copper Cupolas Handmade in New Orleans

Copper cupolas add value and beauty to the exterior of your home while also protecting it from heat and the elements. Architects and designers agree that few additions to your home allow it to both function better and look better at the same time like the cupola! Cupolas provide your attic with extra ventilation, which means lower energy costs for you. Unlike adding a fan or standard attic vent, though, cupolas also add beautiful ornamentation to the top of your home. So, not only will you lower your energy bill, you’ll also be preserving your roof by letting air escape and protecting it from what the elements could do.

Historic Beauty

Copper cupolas have their origins all the way back in the Roman Empire. In Italian, cupola means “little cup.” If you see the type we carry, though, at over five feet tall, you’ll know there’s nothing little about them. While most cupolas have traditionally been copper domes, today they come in a number of different forms. Also, whereas in the past, cupolas have sat atop government buildings and important monuments, they are seeing a surge in popularity across neighborhoods all throughout the country.

The Best for Your Home

Along with looking great, copper is the best choice for cupolas because it’s such a durable metal. Plus, ours are handmade here in the US. You’ll enjoy the beauty and tradition of your cupola for years to come. The handmade, copper finish makes for an eye-catching look while adding some glamour and polish to your home. Both a lookout and functional vent, the cupola is a multipurpose item perfect for homes of all sizes. They can even be used as a lantern! While they were once found only on large buildings, you’ll see them popping up on roofs of homes across the country. Their popularity has increased as homeowners look for unique and functional ways to adorn their homes. At Crescent City Copper, you’ll find regal, high-quality options for cupolas. As you can see above, our copper cupola features a lovely traditional style. The tip of the cupola slopes down softly to create a seamless, polished cap. Beneath the cap, you’ll find the square base. Each vent has been carefully installed for a smooth appearance. This piece is more than an adornment; it’s a fantastic work of art for your home’s exterior! Our copper cupola with a dome is certainly a sight to behold. If you love stately pieces, then you’ll adore this cupola! Handmade from copper, this piece features a pointed tip, which curves down into the real showstopper: the dome. Notice how the copper plays with the light, creating a softly textured finish. The vents add to the cupola’s design while allowing light and air to easily move in and out. A fleur de lis design graces the lower portion of the cupola for a finished look that’s distinctly New Orleans. We’re happy to manufacture any cupola to your specifications. Just let us know the size you’d like, and we’ll get started on your custom copper cupola.

name: Copper Leader Heads/Conductor Heads
description:
Copper Leader Heads/Conductor Heads

Copper leader heads or conductor heads make the perfect architectural accent to copper gutters. These pieces are also known as collector boxes or scupper boxes and add both style and function to your gutter system.

In addition to serving as an accent piece – these leader heads also allow for improved water collection and dispersion especially during periods of heavy rainfall.

Please call 1-877- 251-5327 with any questions or with custom orders!

Historically Beautiful

Leader or conductor heads have an interesting history as they have always been an important aspect of nearly all homes. Originally, water flowed through gutters to one single pipe as their outlet. Leader heads or conductors heads would serve as joints but often caused disastrous leaks.

Today’s leader heads have been completely reworked and modernized. They are now available in a variety of materials, shades, and styles.

So, instead of being merely a functionable item, they serve as decorative pieces as well. They allow for the proper flow of water but can also be styled to suit your home. An ornamental design adds to the overall beauty of your home.

They also allow for easy drainage of water and protect your home from water damage. You can even use them as a catch basin to avoid clogs and facilitate the function of your gutter system.

Copper is the Superior Choice

Conductor heads are typically made of copper, aluminum, and galvanized metal. Each material has its purpose, but copper has come into fashion in recent years for good reason.

Galvanized metal lends itself to corrosion quite easily, while aluminum often fails to stand the test of time. Copper, on the other hand, is quite durable.

Instead of becoming corroded as the years go by, copper develops a beautiful, natural patina. This occurs due to humidity and moisture in the environment.

Patina develops as way to protect the copper and further increases its durability. This is one material that does the hard work for you!

So, it’s no surprise that copper is popping up as popular choice for leader or conductor heads across the country. You can expect your copper leader heads/conductor heads to last for years to come!

Yes, a material this gorgeous is low-maintenance too. No need to repaint the surface every year as you would need to do with galvanized metal.

Our copper leader heads are made to work as lovely accent pieces for your home.

Of course, copper is quite malleable, which allows our team at Crescent City Copper to customize your leader heads or conductor heads. We’ll work with you to create a piece that suits your taste and the architectural design of your home!

name: Copper Louvers
description:
Copper Louvers

Copper roof louvers can be installed on almost any roof and will provide additional ventilation for attic space and help you save money on electricity every month. While they allow in light and air, their angled slats keep out direct sunlight, rain and even noise. It doesn’t hurt that they look great from the outside too.

These days, louvers are more important than ever because they can help lower your monthly energy bill. Take dryer louvers as an example. You can siphon excess heat through your home’s ducts and then out a strategically placed louver. Many people also use louvers as a fashionable way to ventilate their attics without allowing in the elements. No ducts are needed for this process, just install the louver and heat will naturally find its way out.

While louvers come in lots of styles, copper is by far the best material for this fixture. For one thing, copper looks amazing and works with homes that have a stone, brick, stucco, or wood exterior. There’s simply no material copper doesn’t accentuate. Plus, our environmentally friendly copper can put up a fight against the elements. So, no matter what kind of climate you live in, no amount of rain, sleet or snow is going to end your investment early.

Take a look at our gallery of handmade copper louvers above for a better idea of how one might look on your home. Each one of them is from right here in the US.

name: Copper Roof and Copper Dryer Vents
description:
Copper Roof and Copper Dryer Vents

Copper roof vents and copper dryer vents are a way to keep unwanted elements out of your home while expelling the hot air from the dryer or attic. Not only will they help you keep your heating and cooling costs down, they also offer a unique and beautiful way to accomplish this function and enhance the appearance of your home.

Roof vents provide your roof or attic with ventilation, so all the hot air trapped in your roof has somewhere to go. Heat rises, of course, meaning it naturally ends up at the highest points in your house. However, without a way to escape, it can not only force you to spend more on cooling your home down, it could even cause your attic damage.

But by simply installing a roof vent, that hot air leaves your home naturally without the use of ducts or fans.

For a better version of the traditional roof vent, choose one that’s made from copper. As you probably already know, copper is a beautiful metal that can go with just about any housing material it’s paired with. Plus, it’s extremely durable, which means that all the heat running through it and any of the rain, sleet or snow coming down on it won’t cause you any problems.

Take a look at our handmade copper roof vents above, all from right here in the US.
